transcript.content: Hello, I'm Dr. Smith. It's nice to meet you; what brings you in to see me today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Well, I came in because I just barely sleep in any useful way anymore. I'll lie awake in bed replaying client models in my head... and then I usually wake up for good at 3 or 4 in the morning with my stomach all tight. I just end up going to work feeling like I never actually rested.
How long have you been experiencing these sleep issues and this general feeling of tension?
It's been going on for about three years now. It started, well, ever since the merger reorganized our Caribbean-market division. I've just been dealing with it since then.
Outside of your work projects, do you find yourself constantly worrying about other aspects of your life, like your health, finances, or family?

Not really, no. Um... my finances are fine, and I don't really sit around worrying about my health or my family. It's... I don't know, it's not like a constant panic about those other things. It's really just the work stuff and... just feeling so drained and tense all the time. But outside of that, no, I wouldn't say I worry about the rest of it.
During these past three years, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless most of the day, nearly every day?

Yeah, I have. It's... it's really most days. I just kind of move through the office, and even my apartment, with this heavy, gray feeling. It's like I'm just going through the motions. Honestly, it takes a lot of effort just trying not to cry when someone asks me a completely normal question. It's just been this constant, low point for a long time now.
In the three years that you've been feeling this way, have you had any periods of two months or longer where you felt like yourself again and didn't have these low moods?

No, not really. Um... maybe a day or a weekend here and there where things felt a little lighter, but definitely not two whole months. It's just been this constant weight the whole time. I haven't had any real break from it.
During these past three years, have you experienced times where you had trouble concentrating or making decisions, even on simple tasks?

Yes, absolutely. It's actually been a huge problem at work. Spreadsheets that used to be second nature to me now take hours to get through. I just... I lose the thread of what I'm doing. I end up rereading the exact same assumptions over and over again, and even then, I still worry I've missed something completely obvious right before I have to give a presentation. It's just very hard to keep my focus.
Have you noticed any significant changes in your appetite or your weight during these past three years?

No, I haven't really noticed anything like that. Um, my weight has stayed pretty much the same. I guess I just eat out of habit, mostly, so there haven't been any big changes in my appetite or on the scale.
Have you found that you've lost interest or pleasure in the hobbies or activities that you used to enjoy over these past three years?
No, I haven't really noticed that. I still enjoy the things I've always liked doing. Um... I still read and do my usual hobbies on the weekends. So, no, I wouldn't say I've lost interest in them.
